spans.s:
1. Vena occurs in one passage of the Rigveda as a generous patron. pṛthavāna, found in the same passage, may or may not be another name of his, and pārthya in the following stanza of the hymn is perhaps his patronymic.
Foot notes x. 93, 14. Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 166.

2. Vena in the Rigveda is thought by Tilak to be the planet Venus. But this is certainly impossible.
Foot notes x. 123.
Oriea, 163 et seq
Cf. Whitney, Journal of the American Oriental Society, 16, xciv.
